reports.title: Viasat Releases Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results

lines: In Q2 FY2027, DAT earned about $420 million of firm awards, and our current fiscal year 2027 plan anticipates about $2.0 billion of awards, compared to $1.6 billion last year.
Capital Expenditures: We now expect FY2027 capital expenditures of between $850 million and $900 million, including approximately $250 to $300 million for Inmarsat related capital expenditures.
Operating and Free Cash Flow: For FY2027, we continue to expect operating cash flow to be flat YoY with free cash flow generated now expected to improve to more than $225 million.
